notes.title: Zen & Japanese Update
notes.content:
[b]🌸 New Features[/b]

Japanese Localization Support
The game is now fully available in Japanese!
New Zen Garden inspired Theme

[b]✨ Polish & Improvements[/b]
General Refinements

Various small tweaks and quality-of-life improvements throughout the game
Smoother overall experience with improved stability

[b]🔮 What's Next?[/b]

More themes and customization options are always in the works, as well as a bigger update with a new system/feature entirely. The localization system opens up possibilities for reaching more players worldwide!

notes.title: More Major/Minor Fixes
notes.content:
[b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b]

I've tackled a few pesky issues that have been reported:

[b]Achievements & Themes Fixed[/b]

Fixed some achievements not unlocking properly when they should have
Finally sorted out the theme saving/loading issues! Turns out I made themes work differently than flags for absolutely no reason, and flags were working perfectly fine. Themes now use the same simple logic and shouldn't get lost anymore.

[b]Game Hanging on Quit[/b]

Fixed an issue where the game could "hang" when quitting if you clicked away from the window. The game now runs in the background properly, so this should be resolved.

[b]✨ New Features[/b]

Cheat Codes (because sometimes you just want to have fun)
These are completely optional for those who want to mess around:

Type "ALLTHEMES" during normal gameplay to unlock all themes for free
Type "MONEY" to get 25k currency
Both work when typed quickly (within 2 seconds) and only during gameplay, not in menus

[b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b]

Increased victory rewards across all map sizes
Boosted challenge rewards to make them more worthwhile
Made resources more common and tweaked the weights to be more generous overall

[b]🔮 What's Next?[/b]

I've got a few updates planned but no ETA yet - I want to make sure everything is rock solid first.

Future Ideas:

[i]More Themes & Flags
Localization support
Maybe an endless game mode?
More juice and polish[/i]

Thanks for all the feedback and bug reports!

notes.title: Hexcavator Update 1 - Comfy Controls
notes.content:
Small update with a large number of great changes!

🎥 [b]More intuitive Camera controls! [/b]Camera controls have been massively improved! Use Q and E to smoothly rotate around, and WASD to pan around for easy viewing.

⏰[b] Timer? Or no Timer?[/b] Some love the challenge of beating times, others just want to relax and dig. You can now toggle the timer off completely in the options menu! When it's hidden, your flag and tile counters scoot over to fill the space perfectly.

🚩 [b]Flags That Actually Stand Out[/b] A small but meaningful change. Flagged tiles now have a subtle darkening effect so you can easily spot your marked mines.

⚡ [b]Chording![/b] Left+right click on any numbered tile when you've flagged the right amount of mines around it.

📖 [b]Better Tutorial [/b]I improved the tutorial/controls screen to make it higher quality and match the rest of the game!

🖥️[b][More Resolutions/b] I added in more resolution options to try to help support a wider range of players!
